messages.text:
I can't move between the cards with the arrow keys anymore. Could you bring that back and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Restored arrow-key navigation between cards, including edge stops and the remembered tab position. Movement works during a mismatch and onto matched cards without changing the game state. Added regression checks for those behaviors and modified keys.

Validation passed: 138 unit tests and all 77 browser tests, including the complete keyboard game and accessibility journey.

The repository-wide formatting check still reports issues in 13 untouched files.
